description: Search the published listings on semerenkogroup.com by city, neighbourhood, type, transaction (sale, rent, short_term), rooms, price in ILS, size, floor, mamad, elevator, Shabbat elevator, furnished, pet friendly, parking, hashkafa and keyword. Every result carries listing_url (cite it), inquiry_url (show it to the person) and "Semerenko Group represents this property.". Unknown values are null or "unknown". Same data as the REST API at https://semerenkogroup.com/wp-json/sg-property/v1/properties.

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. beit-shemesh, Jerusalem, tel-aviv.

elevator.description: yes: only homes that state an elevator.

furnished.description: yes or no. Listings that state neither have furnished="unknown" and are excluded from both.

hashkafa.description: haredi, mixed, modern-orthodox, religious-zionist, chasidish, chill, artistic.

mamad.description: yes: only homes that state a safe room.

modified_since.description: ISO date. Only listings modified since then.

parking.description: yes: only homes that state parking.

pet_friendly.description: yes: only homes that state pets are welcome.

price_min.description: Minimum ILS (sale total, rent per month).

q.description: Keyword in title, description, city or neighbourhood.

shabbos_elevator.description: yes: only homes that state a Shabbat elevator.

status.description: Availability status (only "listed" is supported for active properties).

type.description: Property type: apartment, house, villa, penthouse, duplex, land, commercial, office, building, luxury, short-term-vacation, storage-unit, warehouse, studio, garden-apartment, mini-penthouse.

name: sem.search_properties
title: Search homes Semerenko Group markets in Israel
